population: Complete English master, 38,926 records; not limited to Fun/EU

stratifiedSelection.algorithm: Sort IDs within each source category by SHA256(UTF8("semantic-pilot-v1|" + id)); choose first 2

limitations: Disproportionate category coverage; not prevalence weighted.
